full_judgment:
32. In spite of the presumption of truth attached to oral evidence under oath if the Court is not satisfied, the evidence in spite of oath is of no avail. 

 36. It is true that crime like murder is shocking in nature and also, revolting. The Crime is against society and humanity, but the prosecution convicted the above accused merely on suspicion. There cannot be conviction for murder on mere suspicion or presumption. The commission of murder must be proved. The presumption cannot take the place of positive evidence, (1970 PCr1LJ 166).
